]

# Connections: A-X1, A-N_b1, X1-N_b1, X1-X2, N_b1-X2, X2-B

def simulate_resistance(r_values, node_a, node_b):
    """Simulate resistance between two nodes given resistor values"""
    R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6 = r_values
    
    # Build conductance matrix for nodes: A, X1, N_b1, X2, B
    # Node indices: A=0, X1=1, N_b1=2, X2=3, B=4
    
    nodes = {"A": 0, "X1": 1, "N_b1": 2, "X2": 3, "B": 4}
    n = 5

    # Add conductances

    G[0, 0] += 1/R1
    G[1, 1] += 1/R1
    G[0, 1] -= 1/R1
    G[1, 0] -= 1/R1
    
    # R2: A-N_b1
    G[0, 0] += 1/R2
    G[2, 2] += 1/R2
    G[0, 2] -= 1/R2
    G[2, 0] -= 1/R2
    
    # R3: X1-N_b1
    G[1, 1] += 1/R3
    G[2, 2] += 1/R3
    G[1, 2] -= 1/R3
    G[2, 1] -= 1/R3
    
    # R4: X1-X2
    G[1, 1] += 1/R4
    G[3, 3] += 1/R4
    G[1, 3] -= 1/R4
    G[3, 1] -= 1/R4

    G[2, 2] += 1/R5
    G[3, 3] += 1/R5
    G[2, 3] -= 1/R5
    G[3, 2] -= 1/R5
    
    # R6: X2-B
    G[3, 3] += 1/R6
    G[4, 4] += 1/R6
    G[3, 4] -= 1/R6
    G[4, 3] -= 1/R6
    
    # Apply 1A current between node_a and node_b
    I = np.zeros(n)
    idx_a = nodes[node_a]
    idx_b = nodes[node_b]
    I[idx_a] = 1
    I[idx_b] = -1
    
    # Solve G * V = I (with reference node)

    I_reduced = I[:-1]
